0.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TISTABIE_00612_TISTABIE_000_000
0.description: Oh, a new drone has fluttered into the Beehive! But are you sure that your patron won't mind?

1.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TISTABIE_00612_TISTABIE_000_010
1.description: Back for some more “High or Low,” are we? I knew you'd be unable to resist...
1.translation_description: Ancora un’altra partita a «alto o basso»? Sapevo che non avresti saputo resistere...

2.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TISTABIE_00612_TISTABIE_000_020
2.description: Oh my, you are a naughty one sneaking back in here just to see me. I heard you'd stirred up quite the hornet's nest. And you look ever so uneasy... How about a little game to relieve some of that tension?
2.translation_description: Oh, che birbante! Torni a sgattaiolare qui di nascosto solo per vedermi. Ho saputo che hai scatenato un bel vespaio. E sembri così a disagio... Che ne dici di una partitina per sciogliere un po’ la tensione?

3.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TISTABIE_00612_TISTABIE_000_040
3.description: I'm sorry, little drone... My head is all...foggy.

4.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TISTABIE_00612_TISTABIE_000_050
4.description: Though the world may be falling down around us, there's no reason to deprive ourselves of life's pleasures. Can I tempt you with a little game, my dear?
4.translation_description: Anche se il mondo ci crolla addosso, non c’è motivo di privarci dei piaceri della vita. Ti va una partitina, tesoro?

5.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TISTABIE_00612_TISTABIE_000_060
5.description: Most people buzz about during the day, whereas I am a creature of the night. After all, the best games are played after dark, wouldn't you agree?
5.translation_description: La maggior parte delle persone svolazza di giorno, mentre io sono una creatura notturna. Del resto, i giochi migliori si fanno dopo il tramonto, non trovi?

10.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TISTABIE_00612_TISTABIE_000_510
10.description: “High or Low” is a guessing game. You must decide whether the total of your three cards is higher or lower than the total of your opponent's cards.
10.translation_description: «Alto o basso» è un gioco in cui bisogna indovinare: devi decidere se la somma delle tue tre carte è maggiore o minore di quella delle carte dell’avversario.

11.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TISTABIE_00612_TISTABIE_000_511
11.description: The deck holds nine cards, with the pictures printed thereon representing the numbers one through nine. Each number appears only once in the deck, so there are no repeats.
11.translation_description: Il mazzo contiene nove carte, ciascuna raffigurante un numero da uno a nove. Ogni numero compare una volta sola, quindi non ci sono doppioni.

12.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TISTABIE_00612_TISTABIE_000_512
12.description: If you guess correctly, then you win the match. If both totals are the same, then another hand is dealt.
12.translation_description: Se indovini, vinci la partita. Se i due totali sono uguali, si distribuisce un’altra mano.

13.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TISTABIE_00612_TISTABIE_000_520
13.description: Oh, you mustn't tease me like that... If you change your mind, my naughty little drone, I'll be waiting.

14.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TISTABIE_00612_TISTABIE_000_530
14.description: Come then, honeybee. Let's have some fun.
14.translation_description: Dai, ape mia. Divertiamoci un po’.

15.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TISTABIE_00612_TISTABIE_000_531
15.description: Three cards for you, three cards for me. You flip one of yours over, and I flip two of mine.
15.translation_description: Tre carte a te e tre a me. Tu ne scopri una e io ne giro due.

16.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TISTABIE_00612_TISTABIE_000_532
16.description: Now, what's your call? Will your total be higher or lower than mine?
16.translation_description: Allora, cosa scegli? Il tuo totale sarà più alto o più basso del mio?

20.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TISTABIE_00612_TISTABIE_000_536
20.description: You're going with “low,” then? Right, let's see what we've got...
20.translation_description: Hai scelto basso, quindi? Bene, vediamo cosa abbiamo...

21.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TISTABIE_00612_TISTABIE_000_537
21.description: You're going with “high,” then? Right, let's see what we've got...
21.translation_description: Hai scelto alto, quindi? Bene, vediamo cosa abbiamo...

22.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TISTABIE_00612_TISTABIE_000_538
22.description: My cards add up to <hex:022003E80203>. And you have...
22.translation_description: Le mie carte valgono <hex:022003E80203> punti. E tu hai...

25.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TISTABIE_00612_TISTABIE_000_541
25.description: Well, it seems luck was on your side. Or perhaps it was more than that...
25.translation_description: A quanto pare, la fortuna è stata dalla tua parte. O forse c’è dell’altro...

26.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TISTABIE_00612_TISTABIE_100_541
26.description: How does victory taste? Sweet as nectar, yes?
26.translation_description: Che sapore ha la vittoria? Dolce come il nettare, vero?

27.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TISTABIE_00612_TISTABIE_110_541
27.description: So, our little game ends with you on top...
27.translation_description: E così la nostra partitina finisce con te sopra di me...

28.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TISTABIE_00612_Q3_120_541
28.description: Can I tempt you with another game?

29.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TISTABIE_00612_TISTABIE_130_541
29.description: Stay with me a while longer, my dear.
29.translation_description: Resta ancora un po’ con me, tesoro.

30.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TISTABIE_00612_TISTABIE_140_541
30.description: So you wish to end on a high note? Perfectly understandable.
30.translation_description: Vuoi chiudere in bellezza? Capisco benissimo.

31.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TISTABIE_00612_TISTABIE_000_542
31.description: Aw... Sorry, honeybee, but this match goes to me.
31.translation_description: Oh... Mi spiace, ape mia, ma questa partita è mia.

33.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TISTABIE_00612_TISTABIE_000_544
33.description: That's what I like to hear. Let me shuffle the deck...
33.translation_description: Così mi piaci! Ora mescolo le carte...

34.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TISTABIE_00612_TISTABIE_000_545
34.description: Had enough for now? Fine, fine─I'll be sitting right here should the mood strike you.
34.translation_description: Per ora basta? Va bene, va bene... me ne starò qui, nel caso ti venisse voglia.

35.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TISTABIE_00612_TISTABIE_000_546
35.description: Oho, it seems we came out equal. But as lovely a coincidence as that may be, we still need a clear winner...
35.translation_description: Oh, pare che siamo in parità. Ma per quanto sia una coincidenza deliziosa, ci serve comunque un vincitore...
